name: Sumerians
dailyLife: Farmers, scribes, and priests living in the first true cities.
facts: They brewed the first known beer recipes.
Their cities had advanced sewer systems.

name: Early Hominids
dailyLife: Nomadic hunter-gatherers following seasons and herds.
facts: They learned to shape stone by chipping it carefully.
They cared for their sick and elderly.

name: Ancient Greeks
dailyLife: Citizens debating in agoras, watching plays, and trading.
facts: They valued physical fitness as much as mental sharpness.
Their pottery styles changed like modern fashion trends.
They invented the alarm clock (water clock).

name: Inca Empire
dailyLife: Living in high-altitude stone cities, farming terraces.
facts: They didn't use wheels for transport because of the steep mountains.
They used knotted strings called Quipu to keep records.
They built earthquake-resistant stone walls without mortar.

name: Ancient Egyptians
dailyLife: Farming the Nile banks, building monuments, praising gods.
facts: Both men and women wore makeup for sun protection.
They loved board games like Senet.
